verification.sourceDerivedHarnesses: Membership tests import the actual WorkspaceStore via verify_workspace_members_efficiency.mjs. Tab-update harness strips workspace.js imports and injects the actual store exports. Both suites passed. No unrelated pin failure observed; neither existing harness nor tests edited.
verification.wholeCombinedSuite: Not rerun; selected 62 offline tests cover the changed exports, membership transactions, UI-derived consumers and retained sync-size optimization. Browser/native tests are outside authorization.

gate.gate: For each exported function and valid small/typical/large workload, compare median process CPU microseconds per operation from 11 warmed alternating before/after pairs. More than 3% regression for the same workload in both independent rounds requires rejection or bounded recheck. Preserve every sample including warmups and outliers. No allocation result overrides this gate.
gate.timingIncludes: full uninstrumented module exports; reconcile receives prebuilt current-session member sets, with per-operation record replacement included, fixture creation excluded

cpu.outlierPolicy: All samples retained, no trimming or discarded runs; calibration and all warmups retained.
cpu.uncertainty: Small sidebar round 1 +3.10% and large sidebar round 1 +4.14%, neither repeated in round 0. Small initial calibration batches ran below the target after warmup/JIT. Host load, JIT and GC vary; no CPU speedup claim. Gate passes only its predeclared repeatability rule.
cpu.scope: Uninstrumented full-module exports, valid small/typical/large saved stores; current-session reconciliation. Previous-session correctness covered differentially, its CPU is not measured.

objectionsAndLimits: Source counters establish removed wrapper constructions; V8 can eliminate allocations, so counters do not measure actual bytes.
Indexes remain transient and retain containing spaces during each operation. No retained-reference lifetime, peak heap, physical RAM, whole-browser memory or whole-browser speed gain is established.
Map interception permanently checks direct values but cannot detect unrelated discarded allocations; source-bound scratch construction counters and exact source diff supply that evidence.

Initial scratch harness path and frozen-proxy/throwing-getter inspection errors were corrected; final 244 comparisons pass on both runtimes. No production issue or repeatable CPU gate failure occurred.
